metas.name: areca palms - Arcea palms
metas.note: Areca Palms can be recognised by their very thin trunk and a small crown. They are mainly found in the southeast.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: https://www.plonkit.net/.

metas.name: Barren mountain trails - Barren mountain trails
metas.note: Barren mountain trails are found in the northern parts of the coverage.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: https://www.plonkit.net/.

metas.name: biratnager car - Biratnagar car
metas.note: An orange orange car with a blue ribbon on the front is found around Biratnagar.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: https://www.plonkit.net/.

metas.name: black spoiler - Black spoiler
metas.note: A car with a black spoiler is found just around Janakpuj, southwest of Kathmandu.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: https://www.plonkit.net/.

metas.name: blocky grey truck - Blocky grey truck
metas.note: A blocky grey truck can be found east of Birgunj and just south of Kathmandu.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: https://www.plonkit.net/.

metas.name: blue car - Blue car (No Antenna)
metas.note:
A blue car is found around:

Pokhara, under the Nepal label

Birgunj, southwest of Kathmandu

Malangawa, near the Indian border southeast of Kathmandu.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: https://www.plonkit.net/.

metas.name: blue car antenna - Blue car (With Antenna)
metas.note: If the blue car has an antenna, you will be around Pokhara.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: https://www.plonkit.net/.

metas.name: canola - Canola
metas.note: Canola, a crop with bright yellow flowers, is mostly found in a few southern pockets in the western half of Nepal.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: https://www.plonkit.net/.

metas.name: chir pines - Chir Pines
metas.note:
Chir Pines, which can be identified from their generally smooth-looking conical or spherical crowns with very long needles, are found everywhere in the mountains, but are much more common in the west, and near Kathmandu.

NOTE: The eastern region is generally greener than the west.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: https://www.plonkit.net/.

metas.name: dark, - Dark, overcast forest
metas.note: Around the southern tip of the Nepalese coverage, you will get this dark, overcast coverage inside a forested valley.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: https://www.plonkit.net/.

metas.name: dried out glacial valley - Dried out glacier
metas.note:
East of Gokyo, you reach this dried out glacial valley, with bright grey rocks as far as you can see.

NOTE: This valley can less commonly be seen from the trail north of Gokyo.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: https://www.plonkit.net/.

metas.name: far brighter - North of Phakding
metas.note: North of Phakding you will get more overcast coverage in the same forest valley, however here the coverage is far brighter.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: https://www.plonkit.net/.

metas.name: fence - Wooden Fence
metas.note: Fences of varying build quality, made of mainly sticks, are most commonly found in the eastern plains of Nepal.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: https://www.plonkit.net/.

metas.name: fluffy grass - White fluffy grass
metas.note:
Grass with white and fluffy-looking tips is most commonly found just southeast of Kathmandu.

While it can be found in most of the country, it usually won’t look as white and fluffy outside the dark red coloured region.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: https://www.plonkit.net/.

metas.name: foggy - Foggy Road
metas.note: This foggy and gloomy road hosts the only natural forest dominated by east himalayan fir. You can recognise it from all the tall dark trees present around the road. It is located just northwest of Bhimeshwor Municipality, east of Kathmandu.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: https://www.plonkit.net/.

metas.name: glacier - Glacier
metas.note: As you lose sight of the spiky mountains, you cross over a glacier, which is the largest patch of snow covered ground with coverage in the country.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: https://www.plonkit.net/.

metas.name: Green forests - southern coverage
metas.note: Green forests and trees are found in the southern parts of the Nepalese coverage.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: https://www.plonkit.net/.

metas.name: grey car backlight - Grey car with visible backlight
metas.note:
A grey car with a visible backlight can be found in the following areas:

Around Pokhara, under the Nepal label

Around Kathmandu

North of Malangawa, near the Indian border southeast of Kathmandu

East of Itahari, in the east.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: https://www.plonkit.net/.

metas.name: gyoko - Trail to Gokyo
metas.note: Northeast of Namche Bazar, you can find this semi-green river valley with clouds covering all mountains surrounding it.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: https://www.plonkit.net/.

metas.name: half - Half rounded/diamond tiles
metas.note: West Bengal style roof tiles, which are more organised and have small diamond shaped protrusions, are most common in the far west flat region. This hint also works for the half-rounded tiles
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: https://www.plonkit.net/.

metas.name: hazy - Hazy sun
metas.note: You can recognise the trail between Pangboche and Dingboche by the massive mountains, combined with the sun looking somewhat hazy.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: https://www.plonkit.net/.

metas.name: higher - Namche Bazar - Dingboche
metas.note: Slightly east of Namche Bazar, you can find this very overcast trail following the mountainside. There are still some trees around, and the trail is noticeably higher above the valley than other overcast sections with trees.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: https://www.plonkit.net/.

metas.name: irregular clouds - Gokyo - Lobuche
metas.note: The area east of the glacier can be recognised by the many irregular clouds spread across the sky and covering various mountain peaks.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: https://www.plonkit.net/.

metas.name: khumjung - Khumjung village
metas.note:
Khumjung village, situated just north of Namche Bazar, can be recognised by the jagged mountain towering above the village. Almost every house in the village has a green roof.

Beware that there is a label for Khumjung further north, which is not close to the village.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: https://www.plonkit.net/.

metas.name: low clouds  - Trail to Everest
metas.note: North of Dingboche, you reach a high-altitude valley with very low clouds covering the sky and most of the surrounding mountains.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: https://www.plonkit.net/.

metas.name: lukla - Town of Lukla
metas.note: The southernmost coverage in Nepal is situated in the town of Lukla, which can be recognised by the narrow street with relatively large buildings, combined with the extremely dark coverage.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: https://www.plonkit.net/.

metas.name: mount everest - Everest
metas.note: Reaching the endpoint of the coverage, you finally get a stunning view of the world's tallest mountain, Mount Everest.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: https://www.plonkit.net/.

metas.name: namche bazar - Forestline near Bazar
metas.note: A lot of the coverage in the vicinity of Namche Bazar can be summarised as being sunny, with the trails going close to the treeline, meaning you will be either near the top of or just above a forest for most of this coverage. You will generally see barren or snowy mountains in some direction.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: https://www.plonkit.net/.

metas.name: northwest - Namche Bazar - Thame
metas.note: The valley by Thamu can be recognised by the generally forested mountainsides, combined with the angle of the valley, going northwest to southeast.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: https://www.plonkit.net/.

metas.name: orange car - Orange car
metas.note:
An orange google car can be found around:

Nepalgunj in the west

Madi, south of Bharatpur in the central south

Biratnagar in the east

Birtamod in the far eas
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: https://www.plonkit.net/.

metas.name: pangboche - Pangboche
metas.note: Pangboche is a fairly large settlement with fairly bright coverage. The surrounding landscape mainly consists of forested mountains nearby and some taller mountains in the distance.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: https://www.plonkit.net/.

metas.name: phorste - Phorste
metas.note: Phorste is a fairly scarcely built settlement with a massive recognizable mountain close by. There are a lot of dead-looking trees surrounding the village.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: https://www.plonkit.net/.

metas.name: red - Gokyo - Lobuche
metas.note: East of the glacial valley, you get to a somewhat red-coloured, rugged mountainside right next to the trail.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: https://www.plonkit.net/.

metas.name: red car - Red car
metas.note: A red car, that usually has a long antenna, can be found in Kathmandu, and north of Janakpur, which is southeast of Kathmandu.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: https://www.plonkit.net/.

metas.name: rounded tiles - Rounded tiles
metas.note:
Rounded roof tiles are most common in the flat regions south of Kathmandu, but are also prevalent further west.

NOTE: Don’t mix this up with the half-rounded tiles, which are part of the hint below this.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: https://www.plonkit.net/.

metas.name: settelment namche - Namche Bazar
metas.note: Namche Bazar is by far the largest and most densely populated settlement with coverage in Nepal. There is also some coverage looking down on the town.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: https://www.plonkit.net/.

metas.name: sketchy road - Sketchy Road
metas.note: This sketchy yellow/orange dirt road can be recognised from the high elevation landscape with the high elevation oaks. It can be found northeast of Phungling in far northeastern Nepal.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: https://www.plonkit.net/.

metas.name: snowcapped mountains - Snowcapped mountains
metas.note: This dirt track in a northwestbound valley can be recognised by the snowcapped mountains to the northwest. You can find it north of the Khaptad national park in western Nepal.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: https://www.plonkit.net/.

metas.name: spiky - Spiky Mountains
metas.note: Above the U-shaped valley, you get a view of this spiky mountain range. While there are some clouds around the peaks, they are mostly clearly visible.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: https://www.plonkit.net/.

metas.name: sunny - Lukla - Namche Bazar
metas.note: The coverage from Monjo up to Namche Bazar is also within the same valley, however here the coverage is mostly sunny and bright.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: https://www.plonkit.net/.

metas.name: Thame - Thame
metas.note: Next to the village of Thame you can see this snowy, and shining bright mountain range.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: https://www.plonkit.net/.

metas.name: Tobuche - Tobuche
metas.note: Further along the trail, you get this stunning view over Tobuche from the eastern side. The mountains get increasingly covered in clouds to the west.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: https://www.plonkit.net/.

metas.name: triangle roof - Triangular roof
metas.note: In the far east, you will mainly see roofs made of sheet metal with a triangular "window" just below the ridge of the roof, and an outwards sloping section below it.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: https://www.plonkit.net/.

metas.name: triangular pole - Triangel pole
metas.note: In Kathmandu, you’ll find poles with an asymmetrical crossbar, which has a triangular attachment on top of it, as well as a support bar below it.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: https://www.plonkit.net/.

metas.name: western hills - Western hill
metas.note: The western hills can be recognised by the dry landscape, with a lot of exposed hillsides lacking vegetation.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: https://www.plonkit.net/.

metas.name: white car - White car
metas.note:
A white car can be found in the following areas:

Around Butwal, southwest of the Nepal label

On the H10 going to Pokhara

On the H04 east to Kathmandu

On some roads near Kathmandu

Northeast of Birgunj, southwest of Kathmandu

From Janakpur to Lahan, southeast of Kathmandu

Around Itahari, in the east.
metas.footer: Description and images taken from: https://www.plonkit.net/.
